name: sejire
description: SEJIRE — versioned decentralized genealogy on Arweave + AO

scripts.deck:pdf: node presentation/print-pdf.mjs ru && node presentation/print-pdf.mjs en
scripts.deck: npm run deck:pptx && npm run deck:pdf
scripts.solana:dev: VITE_PUBLISH_MODE=solana VITE_SOLANA_NETWORK=devnet VITE_QA_TOOLS=0 npm run dev --prefix apps/web -- --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5173 --strictPort
scripts.solana:build: VITE_PUBLISH_MODE=solana VITE_SOLANA_NETWORK=devnet VITE_QA_TOOLS=0 npm run web:build
scripts.solana:check: npm test && npm run check --prefix apps/sponsor && npm run lint --prefix apps/web && npm run solana:build
scripts.test: npm test --prefix apps/web && npm test --prefix apps/sponsor
